## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One stale line needs fixing: AGENTS.md still tells contributors to run `make test`, but this PR removes that target. The guide says these commands are the only checks a change gets, so a contributor who follows it hits a Make error and the tests never run.

## Changes
This PR renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates README.md to say `make check`. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each repository file and the Makefile targets.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- AGENTS.md:24 — comments — Update the Commands entry to `make check` — If someone follows "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." after this PR, the command fails because Makefile:6 now defines only `check` and `lint`. The new Layout entry at AGENTS.md:12 says "`Makefile` defines the `check` and `lint` targets", which contradicts the guide's own Commands section. — AGENTS.md:26 says this repository has no CI, so contributors following the guide get a Make error and no test run before pushing.

(none)
